headline: Fed minutes reveal growing support for rate hikes
detail: This suggests the Fed might keep rates higher for longer if inflation doesn't cooperate. Higher rates generally pressure growth stocks and tech valuations, which is a headwind for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: No action based on this headline alone, but it reinforces the need to monitor your leveraged positions.

headline: Where we stand on Broadcom after Marvell muscles in on its key customer Google
detail: This news directly impacts the semiconductor sector, a core part of your holdings. Competition and customer shifts can create volatility in chip stocks.
rec: No action based on this headline alone, but monitor SMH and SOXL for any related weakness.

headline: Yields pull back from multi-year highs after Treasury Department says it will double government debt repurchase size
detail: This is a mixed signal. A pullback in yields can be positive for growth stocks, but the underlying reason (Treasury actions) needs monitoring. It might offer some temporary relief.
rec: No action based on this headline alone, as the market digests the Treasury's move.
